column3: The cute white cartoon goat with a red collar and bell looks around curiously, then hops playfully left and right beside the wooden fence, her bell jingling, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The cute white cartoon goat jumps up happily and kicks her back legs in the air, full of mischief, then lands and grins, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The cute white cartoon goat peers through the wooden fence at the bright orange carrots, her ears perk up and she licks her lips with a mischievous smile, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The cute white cartoon goat sneakily squeezes through the small gap at the bottom of the wooden fence into the carrot garden, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The cute white cartoon goat pulls an orange carrot out of the soil with her teeth and munches it happily with her eyes closed in delight, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The cute white cartoon goat hops between the rows pulling up more carrots, leaves and half-eaten carrots scattered all over the soil, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The bearded man in a white shalwar kameez opens the garden gate, sees the goat and the mess, and raises his eyebrows in surprise, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The cute white cartoon goat jumps in fright and dashes toward the wooden fence, pushing her head between the sticks, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The cute white cartoon goat's horns are stuck between the fence sticks, she wiggles and pulls and bleats with a worried face, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The kind bearded man kneels and gently pulls the fence sticks apart, and the goat pulls her head free, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The kind bearded man smiles and pats the goat's head as she happily eats the carrot from his hand, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
The bearded man and the little white goat walk happily together along the village path in warm golden light, the goat trotting beside him, Pixar style 3D animation, smooth motion
